# ADR-3271: AWS backups: RDS automated backup retention setting for database 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Zero retention removes point-in-time recovery.

## Decision

Databases MUST set an RDS automated backup retention setting for database 7 (AWS-backups-7).

## Consequences

Retention meets RPO commitments.
